purpose: Preserve the agreed S01-S06 scope and the current implementation status before corrective work resumes.

sessions.name: Freeze Friday V1
required_scope: Create the V1 Git tag and baseline manifest.
Record commit, Python, dependencies, OS, browser, fonts, locale, timezone, rounding, contract and renderer versions, inputs, sources, hashes, and the exact regeneration command.
Regenerate CROX and AZO from frozen inputs and identify any unexplained material difference.
evidence: release-baselines/friday-v1/baseline_manifest.json records the required environment and identity fields.
The full render, PDF, and pixel baseline passed 82 of 82 checks.

sessions.name: Gate 3 Eligibility and Freshness Contract
required_scope: Gate 4 consumes only the standardized immutable Gate 3 contract.
Validate contract version, report date, financial date, market date, latest filing, subsequent events, probability freshness, valuation status, and issuer warnings.
Return GATE_4_BLOCKED_STALE_GATE_3 when stale and do not recreate or overwrite issuer analysis.
evidence: assess_gate3_for_gate4 validates contract identity, hash, gate, dates, filings, events, probabilities, valuation, and warnings.
Ticker-only and legacy Step 3 input paths are rejected.
Stale and ineligible Gate 3 contracts suppress Gate 4 calculations.

sessions.name: Private Portfolio Schemas
required_scope: Create policy, exposure, holdings, opportunity-set, and approval schemas.
Support EXPOSURE_ONLY, AGGREGATED_PORTFOLIO, and FULL_HOLDINGS modes.
Classify fields as CORE_REQUIRED, CONDITIONAL, OPTIONAL, or REVIEWER_CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLICABLE.
completed: Policy, holdings, opportunity-set, approval, freshness-attestation, and workspace-manifest schemas exist.
Private-input structural validation, reconciliation, and synthetic examples exist.
missing_or_incorrect: The workspace manifest currently requires FULL_PORTFOLIO only.
EXPOSURE_ONLY and AGGREGATED_PORTFOLIO are not supported.
The four required field-governance categories are not implemented system-wide.

sessions.name: Privacy Controls and Input Diagnostics
required_scope: Use a private workspace outside the repository and separate private output directories.
Protect Git, logs, caches, temporary files, PDF metadata, diagnostics, and sensitive files.
Keep private Gate 4 calculations offline by default.
Return privacy-safe diagnostics for missing, expired, or contradictory inputs without invented defaults.
completed: Repository-external private workspace and separate private output directory are enforced.
Git, filename, content, notebook, log, cache, temporary-file, symlink, and diagnostic controls exist.
Private modules prohibit network, telemetry, and logging clients.
Missing, expired, contradictory, nonfinite, formula, and reconciliation failures produce privacy-safe diagnostics.
No policy or portfolio default is invented.
missing_or_incorrect: Private PDF generation is disabled rather than protected by a tested metadata-sanitization pipeline.

sessions.name: Reproducible Blind-Test Baseline
required_scope: Freeze the blind-test manifest before the first run.
Record company, selection date, industry, intended stress characteristics, and the pre-run commit.
Preserve first-run output, errors, warnings, diagnostics, and do not replace the company after failure.
evidence: ODFL was selected deterministically and frozen before the first run.
The first run, stdout, stderr, builder output, warning set, diagnostic, execution context, and artifact hashes are preserved.
The company was not replaced after defects were found.
scope_leakage: Shared facility parsing, reconciliation, and working-capital coverage fixes were implemented during S05 even though follow-on Data Layer strengthening belongs under S06.

sessions.name: Period, XBRL and Accounting Controls
required_scope: Use first-run failures to strengthen quarter, YTD, FY, LTM, instant versus flow, unit, currency, share count, non-calendar fiscal year, 53-week fiscal year, negative denominator, and missing XBRL-tag controls.
Place every implementation change only in the shared Data and Evidence Layer.
sessions.preservation_rule: The regression-governance work remains useful and should be retained, but it must be relabeled as supplemental Phase B testing governance and must not count as S06 completion.
actual_s06_gaps: No complete S06 implementation record exists.
Non-calendar and 53-week fiscal-year handling lack dedicated shared-data validation.
Unit, currency, share-count, and negative-denominator controls are not consistently owned by the shared Data Layer.
Missing XBRL handling is only partially strengthened.
The complete S06 requirement set has not been run through dedicated acceptance tests.

correction_sequence.action: Add the exposure contract, three input modes, and four field-governance categories.
Implement and test private PDF metadata sanitization, or formally revise the accepted requirement if private PDF output remains prohibited.
Implement the complete Period, XBRL and Accounting Controls scope only in the shared Data and Evidence Layer.

resume_instruction: Resume from S03 corrective work. Do not mark S03, S04, or S06 complete until their missing acceptance requirements and tests pass.
